blocks.text: WASHINGTON, DC — Republicans made a final push on Sunday to prevent a predicted thumping in US midterm elections where Democrats are gunning to win control of Congress and impose a first political check on President Donald Trump’s unprecedented pursuit of power. Polls show Democrats are all but certain to take the majority from Republicans
